history.sg_progress: This recommendation is under implementation. The draft ICT accountability framework is currently being finalized, and, once finalized, the Office of Information and Communications Technology will prepare the associated guidance on setting up entity-level governance. The framework and guidance will strengthen overall ICT governance. Delays in implementing this recommendation are due to the level of stakeholder engagement needed for preparing the framework.
